results.name: AISStream 船隻 AIS（WebSocket）
results.notes: THE ONLY genuinely free live AIS feed — global terrestrial receivers, free API key, WebSocket with a bounding-box subscription. Three things to be honest about: (1) it is terrestrial, so vessels roughly 40nm offshore vanish; (2) the vendor's own coverage notes are strongest in European/Atlantic waters and weakest in Asia, which is exactly where HK is — so HK coverage is UNPROVEN, not assumed; (3) it cannot run from a static page, it needs a persistent VPS collector. Measure before building: python3 scripts/test_ais_coverage.py --minutes 10. Dark ships (AIS switched off) need paid satellite AIS and are out of scope. Fallback if that measurement says NO-GO: a free-tier keyed REST AIS provider (VesselAPI and similar) is the next step, but do not add one to this catalogue until a real endpoint has been requested and returns data — vendor marketing pages are not sources.

The 2026 POPULATION CENSUS is being collected during calendar 2026 (by order published in the Gazette on 2025-02-14, one in ten households sampled), so its results are NOT available yet — plan the census layer around 2021 plus the rolling half-yearly statistics tables, and add 2026 when it lands. Dataset subject pages host the tables as XLSX.

results.name: 中原城市指數 CCL／CRI（私人，冇公開 API）
results.notes: Be clear about what this is: 中原 CCL/CRI is a PRIVATE product of 中原地產, not open data. It is published as weekly (CCL) and monthly (CRI) press releases and republished by third parties. No public API exists and the licence is theirs. Options, in order of preference: (1) use the official 差餉物業估價署 index instead — it is free, monthly and unambiguous; (2) if the CCL number matters for narrative, cite it with a link and never present it as our own data; (3) only consider scraping the research page if the citation route proves insufficient.
results.shape: HTML page — title: 地產新聞資訊 | 中原地產

results.name: 天文台 公曆↔農曆對照（通勝／擇日基礎）

results.notes: Full post-analysed track of every cyclone in a year — the honest basis for 'this storm looks like the one in 2023' comparisons, because it is the quality-controlled record rather than the forecast. Build the year into the URL and step back a year when the current one 404s.
results.shape: CSV ~655 rows, cols: Tropical Cyclone Best Track Data (post analysis)

results.name: 入境處 陸路管制站輪候時間（官方 15 分鐘）
results.notes: THE OFFICIAL control-point waiting time feed from Immigration — 15-minute cadence, no key. This is better than reading 口岸通's page: 口岸通 gives a green/yellow/red band, this gives the actual queue time. Keep 口岸通 too — it adds the incident notices and the cross-boundary shuttle waits. Found only by the full CKAN scan; a keyword search misses it. Verified response keys are the control-point codes themselves: HYW, HZM, LMC, LSC, LWS, MKT.
results.shape: JSON object, keys: HYW, HZM, LMC, LSC, LWS, MKT

results.name: 醫管局 急症室輪候時間（15 分鐘）
results.notes: Accident & Emergency waiting time per public hospital, updated every 15 minutes, keyless. Genuinely useful to a resident and rarely seen in dashboards — this is the kind of source that makes a monitor worth opening.

results.name: 水務署 臨時停水通知（5 分鐘）
results.notes: Temporary water suspension notices, every 5 minutes. Directly answers 'why is my water off' — pair with a map of the affected address. Reaches us only after relaxing the TLS cipher security level — if a future client gets a handshake failure here, that is the cause, not the dataset.

results.name: 康文署 即時可訂場節數（羽毛球／籃球／網球／草地足球／排球）
results.notes: !! I PREVIOUSLY DECLARED THIS DID NOT EXIST, AND I WAS WRONG. LCSD publishes the live availability of bookable sessions per venue every 5 minutes, keyless, for badminton / basketball / tennis / turf soccer / volleyball. So the honest answer to 'can we show 訂場情況' is yes — with real vacancy, not a workaround. Every court type is the same path with a different sport segment.

results.name: 新渡輪 下一班船 ETA（1 分鐘）
results.notes: Sun Ferry estimated arrivals, refreshed every minute. The route code goes in the query string — confirm the valid codes from their site before wiring it. · Probed 422, which for these means 'endpoint exists, needs an id'. These are two-step APIs by design: fetch the collection route, then request the ETA for a returned routeId/stopId. A 422 on a bare collection URL is the expected answer, not a broken source.

results.name: 港九小輪 ETA／時間表／票價

results.shape: JSON object, keys: type, version, generated_timestamp, data

results.name: 運輸署 交通數據分析系統（5 分鐘）
results.notes: 403 on every attempt — including with Referer and Origin headers set to hk eMobility, so it is not a simple hotlink guard: the endpoint is likely keyed or IP-restricted. Left in the catalogue as a known-gated source rather than deleted, because it is the live road-speed API behind 香港出行易. We already have TD's speed map and journey time feeds, so nothing is blocked by this.
